content.comment_body: Hello everyone, I'm new to the forum and have a quick question. I'm trying to transfer message texts to the [product_name] operator panel using [product_name] engineering software [version_no]. I've connected the [product_name] base module and successfully downloaded the texts to the controller, but not to the operator device. Can you advise on how to display texts on the operator panel? The message destination is set to both devices. Is additional software required for the operator device? Thank you for your support.

Message texts cannot be uploaded to the operator panel. You need to select the checkbox for either "[product_name] operator panel" or "Both." Also, only activated message texts are shown—the enable input must be set to a logic high.

Thank you for replying. I've set the texts to both, and enabled character selection. The texts display only on the controller, not on the operator panel. I need to use the operator panel to view analog temperature and pressure inputs. Monitoring is working on the controller, but not on the operator panel. I would also like to control two pumps from the operator panel. Any advice? Thanks.
Have you set the IP address of the base module in the operator panel's settings? This is done in the "[product_name] selection" menu. Refer to the attached [document].
Please upload your program in a ZIP archive.

In [product_name] engineering software, I see the operator panel in the network view. From the operator panel itself, if I try to switch to ADMIN mode it fails, and when attempting a download to the operator panel it says the target device does not match.
Did you follow my previous instructions?
Yes, the IP address matches the controller. But when I go into settings and try to switch to admin on the operator panel, it's not allowing me.
On the base module, it's asking for the ADMIN password. Do you happen to know what it is?
The IP addresses for the base module and the operator panel must be different. Example settings: Base Module: IP 192.168.0.3, Subnet 255.255.255.0 Operator Panel: IP 192.168.0.4, Subnet 255.255.255.0
The default password to switch from operator to admin mode is
Yes, that's how they're set up. I meant that from the operator panel I've selected the correct IP of the base module.
I tried "[product_name]" but it didn't work.

Where are you entering the password? In the base module or the operator panel? If you're entering it in the base module and it's not working, maybe the password was changed. As shipped, the password should be [product_name].
I'm trying the password on the base module, and it hasn't been changed since it's new. Is there a way to perform a factory reset?
Use: Tools > Transfer > Factory reset [product_name].
Thanks, now I'm in admin mode. How do I set the operator panel to admin? From the operator panel, when I go through settings and try to switch to admin, it fails.
It seems the operator panel is not connecting to the base module.

The current mode (admin or operator) is the same for both devices. If you get a "Failed to submit" error when accessing from the operator panel, then there is no connection to the base module. Did you set the correct IP of the base module in the operator panel's settings? Is your IT network blocking these IPs? Please provide a screenshot of your network view in [product_name] engineering software.

The base module's IP is 192.168.0.3. From the operator panel selection, I chose 192.168.0.3 as well. Still, I can't view the texts or use any functionality. From the PC, when I try to transfer the program to the operator panel, I get "Target device does not match".
You cannot upload anything to the operator panel, only to the base module.
I see, but the operator panel still isn't connecting to the base module—IP addresses are correct, but every function in settings says failed to submit.

If you've configured everything correctly and the operator panel still won't communicate with the base module, what more can I diagnose remotely? Are the base module and panel connected directly, without a PC or network?
Yes, I tried that as well. Sorry, but I still can't get them to connect. Thank you for your support.
Can you ping both the base module and operator panel from your PC using the same network connection? Thanks,
Please read the entire thread—I mentioned that before.

Hello [user_name], For a proper solution, it's best to upload your project file. If you prefer not to share the actual program, please create a sample project with a simple circuit and configure the message text to display on both base module and operator panel. Could you also share a photo of the IP settings on both devices? Uploading a photo should be quick. Please note that [user_name] has spent considerable time responding to each of your questions; after many posts you still haven't provided the requested program files, screenshots, or photos. Posting repeated queries without giving full information makes it difficult for volunteers to support you.

analysis.insight_summary: The user is encountering difficulties showing message texts and analog values such as temperature and pressure on the [product_name] operator panel using [product_name] engineering software [version_no]. While texts appear on the controller, they do not on the operator panel, and errors like 'Failed to Submit' and 'target device does not match' are present when administering or downloading to the panel. There is a need for seamless integration between the operator panel and controller for effective monitoring and control, yet the workflow is cumbersome and lacks proper guidance. Unclear network configuration steps and vague error messages within the software lead to user confusion and failure to complete tasks.
analysis.user_expectations: Users want an easy method to display message texts and analog values from the [product_name] base module on the operator panel using standard software, as well as clear steps for configuring device and network settings. They expect error messages to be informative and helpful in resolving issues.
